reason: The current uniform sampled-softmax SASRec achieves macro validation HR@10 of 0.5137, while Electronics reaches 0.410; a causal preference branch directly tests whether persistent interests complement its final-position representation. Historical uniform preference fusion reached 0.5375, supporting this direction, whereas recency pooling, recency-weighted supervision, and untied embeddings provide no reason to expand the experiment. Modify model_design for the fusion architecture and training_evaluation for checkpoint compatibility, generated inference, and controlled validation.

plan.model_design: Add preference_proj, preference_norm, and a feature-wise fusion gate to SASRec, preserving its existing constructor arguments and forward(self, seq), ranking_loss(self, seq, pos, negative), and predict(self, seq, candidates) signatures. In forward, reuse raw = self.item_emb(seq), compute padding-masked cumulative embedding sums divided by cumulative nonpadding counts clamped to one, and project and LayerNorm these prefix means; accumulate in float32 and pool only the supplied truncated window, without positional embeddings or temporal decay. After the existing Transformer normalization, compute g = sigmoid(gate(concat(x, preference))) and return ((1 - g) * x + g * preference) * keep, initializing gate weights to zero and bias to -2 so the initial mixture favors sequential features. This follows the historically successful uniform preference branch while avoiding failed exponential pooling and untied output embeddings; retain shared item_emb, item_bias, candidate scoring, the existing uniform cross-entropy over positives plus 64 negatives, and all optimizer, sampling, and architecture settings.
plan.training_evaluation: Update train_one checkpoint handling and PREDICTOR with its writer in main together so working/predict.py imports the updated SASRec, reconstructs it from the existing constructor metadata, and strictly loads every projection, normalization, and gate parameter for all four dataset routes. Preserve train_one(name, device, deadline), pack_history(history, maxlen), the public predict signature, existing variable names, and checkpoint selection by validation HR@10 with NDCG@10 breaking ties. Add lightweight checks for prefix means against explicit masked averages, empty and singleton histories, causality with dropout disabled, finite branch gradients, and agreement between checkpoint-reloaded model scores and generated-predictor scores, preserving training RNG state around diagnostics. Keep preprocessing seed 0, seed_all(42), supplied splits, DATA_DIR = os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR'], trial-local artifacts, single-GPU execution, the 200-epoch environment default, patience, runtime controls, and the shared 43,200 GPU-second budget unchanged. Assess the unchanged pinned 200-user-per-category, 99-unique-negative, seed-42 host validation results against the current 0.5137 macro and 0.410 Electronics scores, treating historical 0.5375 as supporting evidence rather than an achieved result and leaving hidden tests, external data, pretrained weights, and the host evaluator untouched.
